scope: Callgrind instruction-count diagnostic; not native elapsed time or performance acceptance
observations: State::print_utf8 and scalar fallback dominate this mixed combining/emoji workload.
Full-row charge recomputation accounts for approximately 8% of reported instructions across inlined source locations; investigate skipping unchanged charges without changing allocation order.
Standard UTF-8 validation accounts for 6.5% of reported instructions; many short spans use the dependency scalar fallback.
limitations: Native AVX-512 build failed in Valgrind before terminal execution with an unsupported instruction; its partial profile is invalid.
The v3 diagnostic executable is deliberately different from native benchmark and Nix GUI binaries.
Includes initialization and teardown; no history or renderer.
Instruction counts are not wall-clock, hardware-counter or cache-latency measurements.
